description: Na₃Ti₂P₂O₁₀F crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fmm2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.60 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are four shorter (2.48 Å) and two longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. The Na-F bond length is 2.33 Å. Ti is bonded to five O and one F atom to form distorted TiO₅F octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₅F octahedra and corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 9°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-2.09 Å. The Ti-F bond length is 2.16 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-50°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. F is bonded in a square pyramidal geometry to three Na and two equivalent Ti atoms.
